Scene/backdrop: the entrance of a compact, contemporary Japanese apartment, with a neat genkan, small shoe cabinet and quiet neutral interior details.
Subject: Chihiro, a university-age Japanese woman with simple dark shoulder-length hair and understated casual clothes, gently hands a small apartment key to the siblings’ mother, an adult Japanese woman in calm everyday home clothes. The exchange is warm and practical, as Chihiro asks her to feed Mochi while she visits family. Mochi is described in this paragraph as a round white cat, but keep the cat off-scene; the moment is the key handoff.
Character continuity: do not add Hayato or Kotone to this image; the paragraph moment is Chihiro giving the key to Mum. Give Mum a natural, unidealised adult appearance, without implying any unsupported distinctive traits. The key is a simple metal key with no tag or writing.
Lighting/mood: bright, soft morning-to-day interior light, friendly and matter-of-fact.
Composition: medium-wide view at the apartment entrance, key handoff centered and clearly visible, with uncluttered background and no text-like marks.
